meta.title: Account Security
meta.description: Manage your Daily Page password and two-factor authentication.

accountSecurity.heading: Account Security
accountSecurity.subheading: Keep your account protected with a strong password and an authenticator app.

password.title: Change Password
password.description: Use a unique password with at least 8 characters.

twoFactor.title: Two-Factor Authentication
twoFactor.description: Add a one-time code from an authenticator app after your password when you log in.

recoveryCodes.title: Save your recovery codes
recoveryCodes.description: Use one of these one-time codes to log in if you lose access to your authenticator app.
recoveryCodes.regenerateDescription: Generate a new set of recovery codes if you lost the previous set. This invalidates any old recovery codes.
recoveryCodes.warning: Store them somewhere safe. They will not be shown again.

deletion.title: Delete Account
deletion.description: Account deletion is immediate and cannot be undone. Choose what happens to your published posts.

summary.immediate: Your profile, comments, reactions, votes, and access sessions will be removed.
summary.privatePosts: In-progress unlisted posts will always be deleted. Locked unlisted posts are treated like public posts.
summary.username: Your username will remain unavailable for 365 days.

delete.title: Delete my authored posts
delete.description: Delete every post you own, including translations you authored.

deletedAuthor.title: Keep posts as “Deleted author”
deletedAuthor.description: Keep public and locked unlisted posts without an owner, profile link, edit token, or account identifier.

anonymous.title: Keep posts as anonymous
anonymous.description: Keep public and locked unlisted posts without an owner or any stable author linkage.

feedback.missingConfirmation: Choose a post disposition, enter your password, and type DELETE.
feedback.invalidTwoFactorCode: That authenticator or recovery code did not work.
feedback.invalidDisposition: Choose what should happen to your published posts.
feedback.activeQuestAdmin: Transfer or archive every active quest you administer before deleting your account.

feedback.recoveryCodesRegenerated: Your recovery codes were regenerated. Save the new codes now.

feedback.invalidCurrentPassword: The current password did not match.
